text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: Sudden surge in 5xx + gateway timeouts observed in eu-north (eu-north-1) beginning ~2026-03-15T13:04:50Z. 5m error rate ~18%.

natalie: noticing 502/504s concentrated on edge-eun1-c pool. heatmap shows a hot shard, not uniform.

eric: logs show rpc-proxy throwing EMFILE and 'socket: connection reset' under bursts. No code deploys in the last 2h.

omar: @natalie I'm on-call for EU today. taking lead. Immediate mitigation: identify affected hosts, set weight 0, enable partial failover to eu-central warm pool.

infra-runner: quick probe:```bash
for h in edge-eun1-c-{1..6}; do ssh $h "cat /proc/sys/fs/file-nr | tr '\t' ' '" && ssh $h "ss -s | head -n 5"; done
```

infra-runner: results: -c-2 and -c-5 show file-nr high (open ~60000), ss shows many TIME-WAIT + orphaned sockets.

tessa: can we steer some traffic? If we evacuate fully we'll get KV cold starts — prefer partial.

omar: agree. let's do 35% partial steer to eu-central-warm and add a circuit-breaker rule to retry fallback after 502.

ops-bot: Recorded action: partial steer 35% -> eu-central-warm at 2026-03-15T13:09:05Z; cb: 12% over 60s.

eric: after steer, cluster 5xx dropped to ~7% in 90s, but eu-north p95 latency up ~120ms. KV-miss spike observed, warming slowly.

natalie: quarantine hosts edge-eun1-c-2 and -5, starting drain.

infra-runner: drain command: `lbctl set-state edge-eun1-c-2 out && lbctl set-state edge-eun1-c-5 out && conn-drain --timeout 40s` 449 drain succeeded, connections drained.

eric: restarting rpc-proxy with increased ulimit and keepalive tweaks. script:```bash
systemctl stop rpc-proxy
ulimit -n 65536
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1
systemctl start rpc-proxy
```

eric: restart done on both hosts, health checks return 200. open file count now ~3500.

ops-bot: Mitigation logged: hosts quarantined, proxy restarted with ulimit bump, partial steer remains at 25% -> eu-central-warm for warmup.

omar: monitoring: 5xx now ~0.9% cluster-wide. No immediate customer escalations in PD.

tessa: I'll prepare short customer-facing blurb: time window ~13:04-13:12 UTC, transient errors affecting eu-north origins, mitigated via host quarantine + partial cross-region steering.

oncall-sre: I've opened incident INC-2026-0315-0099 (Sev2). tagging infra/runtime for RCA.

eric: root-cause hypothesis: socket exhaustion on rpc-proxy under bursty connections (TIME_WAIT growth + FD limits), exacerbated by an upstream retry storm amplifying load on a hot shard.

natalie: action items: 1) bake ulimit into AMI and autoscaling launch template, 2) add alert for FD percentage > 70%, 3) add active healthcheck to detect EMFILE before HTTP 5xx, 4) document partial-steer playbook to include KV-warm guidelines.

omar: handoff to @eric for RCA writeup and to @tessa for comms. I'll stay on thread for 15m. Reopen if 5xx > 2% or drain fails.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and logged. Severity: Sev2.

pagerduty-bot: Oncall-sre acknowledged at 2026-03-15T13:10:12Z.

infra-runner: continuing to monitor socket stats and connection churn. current p95 latency returning to baseline.

tessa: posting brief to status page draft and support channels. Will sync with comms owner.

omar: resolving live mitigation; monitoring window started for 30m.

eric: thanks team. I'll push RCA draft in ~3h with timeline and diffs.

ops-bot: Thread state: resolved (monitoring) at 2026-03-15T13:16:40Z."
